notes.title: Breach of Contract Now Battle Royale and Last Man Standing
notes.content:
That's right you heard it! Breach of Contract is now moving to an open environment type game. Fight against 30 players on a large map. The last player remaining wins.

Players Free-Fall into the map and through the clouds and once the players smash into the ground they must find a safe spot to find and eliminate the enemy players. The concept of being on top of the sky before the match starts is something new. Don't worry Team-Death Match will still be a thing. However, the Last Man Standing Mode will not be available on the small arena based maps for TDM.

notes.title: Update 1.5
notes.content:
[h1] Update 1.5 [/h1] 
[b] Notes: [/b]

- New main menu
- Back to all English
- Some bug fixes
- Changed Servers back over to US-East
- Added a [u]Last Man Standing Gamemode[/u]

This Last Man Standing Gamemode in Breach of Contract Online is different from the others. This gamemode awards you money for each kill you get. After every kill you have 10 seconds to buy something. You get 40 GP for a kill and 50 GP for a headshot kill. Last player standing wins the match! Once you die you get put back to the main menu. Choose where you land by walking around in the clouds, once the countdown is done you fall into the map and you begin fighting. (There are no in-game pickups at this moment. You get everything from the buy menu.) 
1. Switch Gamemode to FFA
2. 30 player limit
3. On new map "escape"
4. 2 Players minimum to start a match.




[b] New Main Menu [/b]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29838347/55c7f938699077b2a4444f4f9b734ea4784464ec.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Update Version 1.3
notes.content:
[h1] Attention Soldiers! There has been a new update to Breach of Contract Online! [/h1]

[b] Update Notes: [/b]
 
- Better Accuracy when using ADS and increased spread when firing from the hip. 
- Maps have also been changed and improved. 
- Alps and Deployment have both seen some major changes. 
- There is more cover on Alps, and Deployment has a totally different environment.
- Bullet penetration has been modified for a more diverse range of surfaces.
- Wood and metal penetration particles have been added when hitting wood or metal surfaces.
- Soldiers have a Blacked-Out effect. (Playermodel improvement)
- Added a Discord button on main menu, click to join Breach of Contract's Discord!
- Added Chinese Language (Will be a setting for English Language soon.)

[b] Enjoy the new update and have fun! [/b]

[b] Make sure you join the new Discord for the game! [/b]
https://discord.gg/mNrbk4Q



[b] Sneak Peak of next update! Map: Throwback [/b]

notes.title: Breach of Contract v1.0 Released
notes.content:
Proud to announce that we have just released Breach of Contract Online!
After months of development this game is finally been polished up and ready to release! We can't wait to watch all the players begin their journey and grind on our game Breach of Contract Online! So excited to see what the community brings for us to see.

Overall we can't express anymore about how epic and amazing this game has became. Right from the start the player is seen with an Apache chopper swinging by them.
From there just dive right into a match grind and enjoy!
There are plenty of weapons to earn and enemies to kill so hope into Breach of Contract and fight against any player to the bitter end. Fight and become the best.
